turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to decide which model to use for my next storywriting project.
Sure, Alan. What kind of workloads are you planning? Are you doing code generation, summarization, or creative writing?
Mostly creative writing. I've been testing a few, but honestly, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is preferred for deep creative chat and back-and-forth insight workloads. It just flows better.
Understood. I'll note that preference for creative tasks. Did you also want to discuss the hardware order you placed for the new GPU?
Yeah, it's still stuck in customs. Annoying. Anyway, back to the model, do you have any other recommendations for coding?
For coding, you might look at models optimized for logic and syntax, but for your creative needs, we'll stick with your chosen one.
Perfect. Also, did you remember to book the table for dinner on Friday?
I have the reminder set, but I need the restaurant name to confirm the booking. Shall I use the usual Italian place?
